additional_rule: First three previously unqualified 100m PGD0 candidates in (catalog acquisition start, granule UR, concept ID) order from the original-control region, 2024-02-16T00:00:00Z through 2024-02-18T00:00:00Z. Exclude the two named positive controls. Inspect only native rows/columns [0:16,0:16] with stride one and good/suspect policy; no science stream or support expansion. Stop after three; no replacement if incompatible.
catalog_limits: Default CmrClient bounds, limit 20, frozen fixtures for larger matrix.
source_inspection: At most three additional exact-object Earthdata sessions, 64 MiB per source request cap, 4096 plan nodes; serial existing native job preparation with metadata output bound 256 KiB each; process timeout 120s per generator. Transport bytes and timings retained. No science-variable chunks streamed.
workflow: Search both controls, select known windows from examples/swot-job.json, generate inspected/pinned manifest, normal plan, checkpointed fetch then full reconstruction; compare both outputs to guarded original h5py and NetCDF-C references, Zarr-Python and xarray.
